content.summary: Implementation plan for: Single-file row-model refactor in FileList (collapsible dirs + fuzzy filter)

data.goal: Add true collapsible directory nodes and fuzzysort-based filename filter to the /changes sidebar FileList component while preserving stage grouping, selection payload shape, keyboard navigation, and diff-pane coupling.
data.learning_milestone: A user can collapse/expand directory sections under each stage, type a fuzzy query to narrow the file list, and navigate the filtered/collapsed view with up/down/enter without any selection or diff regression — validated by typecheck + manual runtime walkthrough.
data.approach:
The implementation refactors file-list.tsx in three incremental layers that each preserve the existing onSelect/onSummary contract.

First, the flat groups() memo is extended with a collapse-state map (Map<string, boolean> keyed by 'stage:dirName') and a derived visibleRows memo that excludes files under collapsed directories. The existing index/selected/positions signals are rewired to operate over visibleRows instead of the raw files() list, keeping the onSelect payload shape identical. Directory header rows become interactive toggle targets (click and a new hotkey) that flip the collapse map. Collapse state is pruned against current tree paths after refetch.

Second, a filter signal and a fuzzysort-scored derivation are inserted between the raw file list and the collapse/visible-row pipeline. When filter is non-empty, files are scored by path, non-matching files are excluded, and parent directory headers are retained for matching descendants. An inline <input> element is added at the top of the file list with explicit editing-mode state that suppresses j/k/r hotkeys while typing. The '/' hotkey activates filter focus; Escape clears and exits.

Third, the footer hint text is updated to reflect the new hotkeys (collapse/expand toggle, filter activation), and a manual runtime verification checklist confirms comment reset behavior and duplicate-submit prevention.

changes_required.change: Add collapsed state map, visibleRows memo, filter signal with fuzzysort, editing-mode guard, directory toggle rendering, inline filter input, updated keyboard handler with hotkey isolation
Add hints for / (filter), space/enter on dirs (toggle collapse)

technical.challenge: Keyboard isolation when filter input is focused
technical.why_hard: Three independent useKeyboard handlers (route, file-list, diff-pane) all gate only on dialog.stack — an inline <input> is not a dialog
technical.mitigation: Add an explicit 'editing' signal in FileList; check it in the file-list keyboard handler to suppress j/k/r/up/down while typing. Route-level S and Esc already work correctly because they check dialog.stack only.

technical.why_hard: Collapsing a dir or filtering can remove the currently selected row from visibleRows, causing index out-of-bounds or silent deselection
technical.mitigation: After recomputing visibleRows, attempt to find current selected().id in the new list and remap index; if not found, clamp to nearest valid index and emit onSelect for the new item.

technical.why_hard: refetch() rebuilds the raw file list — collapsed dirs may appear/disappear
technical.mitigation: Prune collapse map keys against current tree after each status() update; new dirs default to expanded.

technical.why_hard: If a dir is collapsed but its children match the filter, should they show?
technical.mitigation: When filter is active, ignore collapse state entirely — show all matching files with parent context. Collapse only applies when filter is empty.

skills_required: Understanding of the existing FileSelection contract
risk_factors: Manual testing is required for keyboard behavior — no automated TUI keyboard tests exist
The file-list.tsx will grow from ~280 to ~400-450 lines, approaching extraction threshold

open_questions: Should space or enter toggle collapse on directory rows? (Recommend space to avoid conflict with enter=select which is currently used for file selection.)
Should the filter input be always-visible or toggle-visible via '/'? (Recommend toggle-visible to keep sidebar compact for small change sets.)
When a filter match narrows to a single file, should it auto-select? (Recommend no — let the user confirm with enter to avoid accidental diff switches.)

unit: Not feasible without extracting the transformer — intentionally deferred per Option 1 strategy
integration: Manual runtime verification checklist (see work item 4)

risks.risk: File-list keyboard handler grows complex with editing-mode guard
risks.mitigation: Single boolean signal check at top of handler; if true, only handle Escape and Enter

risks.risk: fuzzysort scoring on paths may rank poorly for deep nested files
risks.mitigation: Use fuzzysort.go() with key: 'path' and verify with 10+ file change sets; the codebase's own DialogSelect uses the same approach successfully

risks.risk: Collapse chevron rendering may misalign in narrow 38-char sidebar
risks.mitigation: Use single-char ▶/▼ indicators at 2-space indent, matching session sidebar pattern
